preamble: The voiced retroflex fricative [ʐ] (the Mandarin r- initial) became the lateral [l] in some Mandarin dialects. In Jinan (Jilu Mandarin), the change is conditioned by a following rounded vowel: ʐ stays in 日 [ʐʐ̩] 'sun' and 熱 [ʐə] 'hot', but became l before u in 如 [lu], 入 [lu], 軟 [luã] and 弱 [luə]. In central Jiangsu (including Yangzhou), Lower Yangtze Mandarin merged /ʐ-/ with /l-/ unconditionally (Ting 1991).

examples.note: Before the rounded vowel u, the r- initial is l in Jinan; before unrounded vowels it is still ʐ (日 [ʐʐ̩21] 'sun').
